description: Source code for managing command categories in a device utility, including creation, destruction, command addition, retrieval, and completion functionalities.

classes.name: _Category
classes.description: Internal structure representing a command category with name, description, advanced flag, and list of commands.

methods.name: categoryCreate
methods.description: Creates a new category with specified name and description.

methods.name: categoryDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a category and frees associated resources.

methods.name: categoryAddCommand
methods.description: Adds a command to a category.

methods.name: categoryGetCommand
methods.description: Retrieves a command by name or short name from a category.

methods.name: categoryGetCompletions
methods.description: Provides a list of command names that start with a given prefix.

methods.name: categoryPrint
methods.description: Prints category details and commands, optionally including advanced commands.
